nodes.description: Public total token supply tracked by ERC20Basic and mutated by SlotTicket.mint.
Mapping of address to token balance; the primary accounting state of the token.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount used by transferFrom and approve.
Privileged owner address; gates onlyOwner functions across SlotTicket and Slot.
Emergency stop flag toggled by pause/unpause and checked by whenNotPaused.
Token name string 'Slot Ticket' exposed by the SlotTicket contract.
Token decimals (0) for SlotTicket.
Token symbol string 'SLOT' for SlotTicket.
Token version string for SlotTicket.
SlotTicket instance created in the Slot constructor and minted on every ticket purchase.
Mapping of participant index to address; winners are selected from this array and paid directly.
Fixed array of prize amounts (4/2/1 ether and 500 finney tiers) paid to winners.
uint8 ticket counter incremented per ticket; overflow wraps at 255 and self-corrupts the lottery.
Constant lottery size (100) used for prize index wrapping.
Constant jackpot odds denominator (1000000).
Constant ticket price (100 finney) used to derive ticket count from msg.value.
Accumulated jackpot balance, incremented per draw and zeroed when awarded.
Monotonic game/draw counter used to scope participant indices.
Operator wallet receiving the 245 finney rake each draw; changeable by owner.
Checked multiplication helper from the SafeMath library.
Division helper from the SafeMath library.
Checked subtraction helper asserting b <= a; used for balance and allowance debits.
Checked addition helper asserting c >= a; used for balance and supply credits.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to _to, debiting and crediting balances.
Constant read of balances[_owner].
Moves tokens between _from and _to using the caller's allowance; allowance is read before state updates.
Sets the caller's allowance for _spender; guarded against the approve race by requiring zero when changing.
Constant read of allowed[_owner][_spender].
OnlyOwner function that reassigns the owner state variable.
OnlyOwner emergency stop that sets paused = true.
OnlyOwner resume that sets paused = false.
OnlyOwner unlimited mint that credits balances and totalSupply for the casino.
OnlyOwner selfdestruct of the SlotTicket contract, sending its balance to owner.
Deploys the SlotTicket instance and stores the operator wallet.
Payable fallback that forwards the caller to buyTicketsFor, making ticket buying the default action.
Payable entry point: takes msg.value, mints tickets, registers participants and refunds change to msg.sender.
Private loop that records participant addresses and triggers the draw when counter hits the boundary.
Private pseudo-random generator based on blockhash of the previous block and a caller-supplied seed.
Draw logic: computes winner index and pays every prize via raw transfer, then increments the game number.
Pays the accumulated jackpot to a participant and zeroes the jackpot state.
OnlyOwner function that destroys the SlotTicket then selfdestructs the casino contract.
OnlyOwner function that changes the rake-receiving wallet.
Caller-controlled address; used as participant, beneficiary, allowance owner, gas refund recipient and initial owner.
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value%PRICE) sends ETH change to the caller before the transaction settles.
participants[winnerIndex+i].transfer(prizes[i]) sends ETH to arbitrary participant addresses inside a loop.
wallet.transfer(245 finney) and msg.sender.transfer(10 finney) perform external ETH transfers after payouts.
participants[_winnerIndex].transfer(jackpot) sends the whole jackpot to a participant-controlled address.
selfdestruct(owner) irreversibly removes the casino contract and forwards its balance.
selfdestruct(owner) irreversibly removes the token contract holding minted balances.
sha3(block.blockhash(block.number-1), _seed) uses miner-influenceable block data as randomness.
uint8 counter++ has no overflow guard; after 255 tickets the index wraps and corrupts participant slots.
Destination address supplied by the caller of transfer.
Amount of tokens to move in transfer.
Address whose balance is queried.
Return value holding balances[_owner].
Source address debited by transferFrom.
Destination address credited by transferFrom.
Amount moved by transferFrom.
Cached allowance allowed[_from][msg.sender] read before state writes.
Address granted an allowance.
Allowance amount being set.
Token holder address queried in allowance.
Spender address queried in allowance.
Return value holding allowed[_owner][_spender].
New owner address; empty check guards against zero address.
Recipient of freshly minted tickets.
Number of tickets minted.
Operator wallet address stored at deployment.
Ticket recipient; supplied by the fallback as msg.sender but callable with any address.
uint8(msg.value/PRICE) tickets derived from the paid amount.
Participant address written into the participants mapping.
Loop bound controlling how many slots the participant occupies.
uint8 loop index over the ticket count.
Modulus bounding the pseudo-random result.
Caller/participant controlled seed mixed into the blockhash.
Derived pseudo-random number returned to the draw.
Seed taken from the participant address and used for winner selection.
rand(SIZE-1, seed) result selecting the winning index offset.
Boolean comparing two rand() outputs to decide the jackpot payout.
gameNumber.mul(SIZE), the base index of the current draw.
start + SIZE computed with unchecked arithmetic as the upper bound.
start.add(winningNumber); mutated in-loop by subtraction, controlling payout destinations.
uint8 index over the prizes array.
Participant index receiving the jackpot.
Replacement operator wallet address.

edges.reason: msg.sender enters the contract through the payable fallback.
msg.sender is forwarded as the beneficiary of buyTicketsFor.
msg.sender is the implicit source of BasicToken.transfer balances.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner set in approve.
msg.sender becomes the privileged owner in the Ownable constructor.
Fallback unconditionally delegates to buyTicketsFor.
buyTicketsFor calls token.mint for the beneficiary.
buyTicketsFor registers the ticket count through addParticipant.
buyTicketsFor writes through the token contract instance.
Buy entry sends the ETH change back to msg.sender while the transaction is still open.
The refund transfer hands control to msg.sender, which may re-enter buyTicketsFor.
beneficiary parameter determines who receives tickets.
numberOfTickets derived from msg.value drives minting and registration.
Ticket count bounds the addParticipant loop index.
beneficiary is written into the participants mapping.
addParticipant writes addresses into the participants mapping.
addParticipant reads and increments the counter state variable.
addParticipant performs an unchecked uint8 counter increment.
counter is the operand of the unguarded increment.
counter++ can wrap at 255 and overwrite earlier participant slots.
the counter boundary check triggers awardPrizes from inside addParticipant.
awardPrizes uses rand for winner/jackpot selection.
awardPrizes calls distributeJackpot when the jackpot is won.
Prize loop performs raw ETH transfers to participant addresses.
Paying a participant-controlled address can re-enter the draw before gameNumber is incremented.
Rake and gas refund transfers execute before gameNumber++ finalizes state.
wallet/msg.sender transfers expose the draw to reentrancy.
awardPrizes reads winner addresses from participants.
awardPrizes reads the fixed prizes array.
awardPrizes accrues the jackpot with SafeMath.add.
awardPrizes increments gameNumber at the end of the draw.
_seed (participant address) seeds the pseudo-random winner selection.
awardPrizes computes winningNumber from rand(SIZE-1, seed).
awardPrizes computes the jackpotWon boolean.
awardPrizes computes the draw start index from gameNumber.
awardPrizes computes the draw end bound.
awardPrizes derives winnerIndex, which selects payout recipients.
awardPrizes iterates the prizes array with index i.
end = start + SIZE is computed with unchecked addition.
winnerIndex is used to index participants for payouts.
distributeJackpot sends the whole jackpot in one raw transfer.
The jackpot transfer to a participant address can re-enter the draw.
distributeJackpot reads the winner address from participants.
distributeJackpot reads the jackpot amount.
_winnerIndex selects the jackpot recipient.
rand derives its output from blockhash, a manipulable randomness source.
_size bounds the random result (always SIZE-1 or JACKPOT_SIZE-1).
_seed is attacker-influenced input mixed into the hash.
rand returns the computed pseudo-random number.
